# action_tutorials_interfaces

`action/Fibonacci.action` is copied unmodified from the ROS 2 Jazzy package
`action_tutorials_interfaces` 0.33.11 (`share/action_tutorials_interfaces/action/`),
from https://github.com/ros2/demos, licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Copyright belongs to Open Source
Robotics Foundation, Inc. and contributors.

It is the action that `ros2 run action_tutorials_cpp fibonacci_action_server`
serves; the tests generate Rust types for it the way users generate theirs.
